appearance_facts.fact: Single blue line with black point markers descending from upper-left (2005) to lower-right (2015); 2011 has no visible marker or label.
Vertical scale labeled 'Temperature (°C)' with printed ticks at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20.
Horizontal scale labeled 'Year' with printed ticks 2005 through 2015.
Each plotted point (except 2011) carries a printed value above it, e.g., $24.0°C at 2005 and $10.0°C at 2015.

public_definitions: Task: 'Review the 2005-2015 temperature monitoring trend and route the record based on whether the multi-year change warrants follow-up under the substantial trend workflow.'
Routing criterion (readonly): 'Magnitude of change across the review period'
Option A: 'Escalate the 2005-2015 temperature decline for follow-up'
Option B: 'Keep the 2005-2015 temperature decline on routine monitoring'
Option C: 'Archive the temperature trend record without targeted follow-up'
uncertain: 2011 has no plotted marker or printed value on the line.
No numeric threshold defining 'substantial' change is provided in the form or chart.
Printed labels include a leading '$' before the °C values (e.g., $24.0°C); treated as the chart's literal annotation.
